topologies_evaluated.name: Topology 1: Process-per-Plugin
topologies_evaluated.pros: Maximum isolation; crashed plugin cannot kill host or peer plugins
topologies_evaluated.cons: High process creation & IPC latency overhead
topologies_evaluated.cortex_fit: Suitable for untrusted / high-risk plugins only

topologies_evaluated.name: Topology 2: Shared Worker Pool
topologies_evaluated.cons: Crash in worker process affects all plugins assigned to worker

topologies_evaluated.name: Topology 3: Tiered / Hybrid Isolation (RECOMMENDED)
topologies_evaluated.pros: Sub-millisecond performance (P50 = 0.226ms) for trusted plugins in-process; SIGKILL preemption and fault containment for untrusted / heavy plugins in worker processes
topologies_evaluated.cons: Requires trust/isolation metadata in capability manifests
topologies_evaluated.cortex_fit: PERFECT FIT with Cortex capability security model
